concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE polished high fidelity launcher desktop window concept for a native lightweight C++ Windows port of Resident Evil: The Umbrella Chronicles. Landscape 1536x1024. Front-facing pixel-crisp UI, no perspective, no computer hardware, no browser. Window almost fills image, small outer neutral margin. Put concept number/name in small presentation caption above window. Russian readable UI. Native window titlebar with minimize/maximize/close. Functional navigation labels "Игра", "Графика", "Управление", "Звук". Active page Графика. Show concise real controls: "Режим окна" dropdown "Оконный"; "Масштаб рендера" dropdown "2× · 2560 × 1440"; "Лимит FPS" dropdown "240"; "Масштабирование" dropdown "DLSS"; "Качество" dropdown "Качество"; toggle "Генерация кадров"; toggle "Пропустить вступительные ролики". Lower compact game folder path field S:\Games\Umbrella Chronicles\game with folder browse icon. Primary large button "ИГРАТЬ", secondary "Сохранить". Small status "Игра найдена". Show reasonable whitespace, consistent controls and font hierarchy, readable actual UI text. No news feeds, store, account, social widgets, advertisements, memory claims, Electron/web references, fake version data or diagnostics clutter. Visual concept only: future DLSS controls included for planning, not claims of current implementation.
Concept: 1 · GRAPHITE. Design direction: Restrained premium native Windows game utility. Dark graphite background, ivory typography, restrained crimson accent. Left vertical sidebar navigation; right spacious two-column settings form; narrow atmospheric train photograph banner at top. Solid flat surfaces, fine separators, compact rounded rectangles, no glow. Elegant and practical.

Concept: 5 · ARCHIVE. Design direction: Resident Evil archive dossier aesthetic translated into an elegant modern desktop launcher. Near-black olive-gray panels, aged ivory typography, muted brass/olive accents and a tiny crimson Umbrella insignia. Top horizontal navigation like file tabs. Left compact cover art thumbnail and game identity; broad right settings grid. Thin crisp rules, restrained fine paper grain on header only. Bottom prominent red launch button. Vintage survival horror identity with modern legibility, no distressed fonts in controls.
